content: In yar animbogoub qamb ibitiri igoun eng igoi seret wogub in ombur Timoti anit imurimune isa wogub in Atens e igorub qamb misir iguminei.
Timoti wo in nob Qenu sarau ebet Munon inubersiau tari qob uber dibes qamb qib igo, eng anit imurimune isub irun wab ne anmusub ne aninou oau apand eng nonogursi qamb imuriaminei.
An qei aningaramb eng abari git goan uter end yari wurit uburab isunon. An mom imbigomanei, Qenu inmaribigor eng, in ende insiarari in bo uberburar qamb.
Qoan in anamar igo mi eng anit dieriner end mom an irun wab ete, anamar qamb igunei: “Qen geret ininob yogurubour.” Eng qamb igoun eng qeemben see gaumon eng.

End ne ye wanin baab me abau. Munon eng qo anit imurimine isub aninou oau apand eng gab yonob qamara animbigib qamb imuriamei. Munon anmurimar anwariges igo eng toat igamari in anit qer omboat igoun eng isi isiner qamb.
3:6-10 Timoti bo diab wurit qob sua igub Pol mismisirarei

Timoti anit imuriamin eng bo se qas e diara nob igoun. Wo diab aninou oau apand igo munon qei wuriqenungar igoumon end qob sua igoun. Ne gor init igub mismisir igoumon eng ne an inimbogoub qamb ibitiri igoumon eng gor qamara igoun. Qamara igub in gor an animbogoub qamb ibitiri igoun.
Io, an yonou wau ima gas ende, in igoun eng an oabig igoumon eng gab in nonoguret ne sarau ebet quguraget qib igoun eng, mi git irimanima, ende qamb in bo igomot igamau gas ende buroun.
Eng ete: An mom Munon Aib tenori mom igorunon eng, in mom igomot igoruboun.
In qenen anit igub ininou Qenu mag qurt mismisir igoun. End ne Qenu wo eng inseara mismisiraun end qenen wot uber qamb igoun.
Itum woromt qenen Qenu qebi qumurune werei ger inimbiga menman animbogoub qamb. Aninou oau apand eng mein bura gab eng bo anmenimune peririeriba.
3:11-13 Pol is ibegeib qamb Qenu qebi qamarei
Ininou tain Qenu wonou ne ininou Munon Aib wurinou werei barsitarari yarab menman qi guboun.
In misir eng, Munon Aib wonou anseara munon qi qenungau qomon eng sig-sig mom ebet igoarar. Igo ne aninou munon banam ne munon gugum wurimusub igoarar. In anqenungar igoun gas ende an gor ende abar.
In qenungoun eng, Qenu ende at annonogursieriner. Qen geret ininou Munon Barai Yisas wonou yurau bo wurinob deriner qen end an munon qoregen ne munon qau ininou Tain Qenu mag qurt end igoruboumon.
